AbilityChannel.description:
An authored permission, not general access to the target's knowledge.

Distance is valid only in the named location. Moving out invalidates it.
Detect facts encode presence/direction/quantity separately from analysis;
thought facts contain only currently authored surface thoughts.
AbilityChannel.title: AbilityChannel

AmmunitionLoad.description: Reserved inventory rounds; they retain mass and cannot be traded/consumed.
AmmunitionLoad.title: AmmunitionLoad

ApproachSupport.description: Evidence that a declared approach uses a supported runtime check.
ApproachSupport.title: ApproachSupport

AttackProfile.description: Server-authored original subset, bound to an implemented equipment entry.
AttackProfile.title: AttackProfile

BackfireAlternative.description: Campaign-authored interpretation of a contextual B236 result.
BackfireAlternative.title: BackfireAlternative

CheckRule.description: Trusted scenario check with catalog skill and modifier provenance.
CheckRule.title: CheckRule

CombatConsequence.description: Authored revelation after recorded incapacitation in a completed encounter.
CombatConsequence.title: CombatConsequence

CustomConstruction.description: A named grouping of purchased catalog components, never new mechanics.
CustomConstruction.title: CustomConstruction

EntangleSpec.description: Explicit binding facts for one entangling weapon mode.
EntangleSpec.title: EntangleSpec

HazardSpec.description: Scenario-owned configuration, never accepted as a player command payload.
HazardSpec.title: HazardSpec

HumanBody.description: Trusted scenario anatomy; absence never selects a human implicitly.
HumanBody.title: HumanBody

InitialResources.description: Only initial resources; runtime history and elapsed time are forbidden.
InitialResources.title: InitialResources

InjuryTolerance.description: Trusted anatomy facts; never accepted as player-authored damage modifiers.
InjuryTolerance.title: InjuryTolerance

PartySlot.description: An actor ID local to this scenario, never an account or membership ID.
PartySlot.title: PartySlot

PublicBrief.description: Explicit author-approved allowlist, never populated from the private graph.
PublicBrief.title: PublicBrief

RatedStrength.description: Explicit B270 weapon ST; never inferred from a skill or ammunition name.
RatedStrength.title: RatedStrength
